She has since plastered it all over social media. I don’t mind it because I can choose to ignore it. But this holiday season she was insufferable. My sister walked out of the room. I thought my family would back me up but instead my parents backed up my sister. My dad didn’t say anything but he was on my sisters side. I don’t know maybe what I said wasn’t the nicest way but I don’t think I was wrong in what I said.
